## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and the reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --all-targets --locked`
- [ ] Documentation and JSON schema notes are updated when needed.
- [ ] No secrets, generated artifacts, emojis, or em dash characters were added.

## Engineering notes

Describe memory bounds, parser behavior, security implications, and compatibility impact when they
are relevant.
